More than a costume

A performer.
A playmate.

I’m Sofie, a children’s party entertainer and Early Childhood Education student. I love bringing characters to life while helping children feel welcome, included and ready to join in.

Singing & dancingInteractive gamesWarm encouragementImaginative play
  • OCTOBER 2024 — PRESENT

    Children’s party entertainment

    Character performer with Mermaid Molly Flora Entertainment. Experience entertaining at 15+ events, including a celebration with approximately 30 children.

  • APRIL 2024 — PRESENT

    Hands-on childcare experience

    Nannying experience supporting young children through play, daily routines and growing independence.

  • 2026

    Learning through early childhood education

    Studying Early Childhood Education at Algonquin College. Completed a preschool placement at Blossoms Childcare, supporting play, routines and positive interactions.
